turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My friends and I want to see the new monster film on Friday and we can't agree where.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Just listen while I lay them all out, and I'll ask for your view at the end.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's the big multiplex with reclining seats, but tickets are pretty pricey.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A tiny independent cinema near the station, cheap, cosy, and they serve proper cake.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or a drive in about forty minutes out of town, which we've never been to.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's the last option, I'm finished. Go ahead.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: For a big monster film, the multiplex will have the best sound and screen, if the price is okay. The independent is cheap and cosy, though the screen is smaller. The drive in is the most memorable night out, just check the weather first.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can I ask about something else? I've got a cupboard full of kitchen gadgets I never use. Spiralizer, waffle maker, and three blenders.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sounds like a museum. A quick test, when did you last use each one?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Honestly? The spiralizer was a January thing. Two years ago.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then it can go. If you haven't touched something in a year, and it's not seasonal, it's probably clutter.
